notes: Build76 is a Lovable Load Stability hotfix. It removes the Build74 documentElement-wide MutationObserver from the Multi-Agent Runtime UI and replaces it with event-driven plus bounded retry mounting, preventing mutation cascades against Lovable's React tree. It also changes Build70 Account Integration Gate readiness checks from unconditional 8-second polling to event-driven checks with 20-second polling only while a logged-in account has incomplete integrations; polling stops entirely when integrations are ready or the tab is hidden. Build75 Universal Agent Bench / External-Agent Hardening remains the final automated Universal Agent Control Plane gate. Every registered agent remains proposal-only with writeAuthority=false and canWriteAuthoritative=false. Build74 Multi-Agent Runtime UI + Native Sessions remains explicit-selection with no approval carry-over. Build73 Agent Sandbox / Shadow Worktree remains proposal-only with path traversal, symlink/hardlink and credential isolation. Build72 Portable Skills v2 remains local-first with writeAuthority=false. Build71 Universal Agent Runtime Registry remains proposal-only. Build70 Account Integration Gate with mandatory GitHub App + Supabase OAuth remains authoritative before project mutation. Cumulative guarantees remain explicit: Build65 USER_EDIT > AI_EDIT; Build66 Smart Undo/Redo with one-shot HEAD-bound confirmations; Build67 Continuity Engine; Build68 Local Agent Orchestrator with zero paid/remote fallback; Build69 DecrypterBench v2 / Hardening with path traversal defenses; Context Engine v2; MCP 2026-07-28 Trust Gateway with one-shot write tickets; Guarded Commit. GitHub App + Supabase OAuth remain mandatory. No OTA metadata, GitHub Release or store publication is authorized until the hotfix release gate passes.
